title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 25
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 25: limits on beating, a husband's brother's duty, honest weights, and Amalek.

questions.text: What was the most stripes a judge could sentence a guilty man to?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says he may sentence him to no more than forty stripes, so that the brother would not be degraded.

answers.text: Twenty
Fifty
One hundred
Forty

questions.text: What does verse 4 say about the ox treading out the grain?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says: "You shall not muzzle the ox when he treads out the grain."

answers.text: It must rest every seventh hour
It must not be muzzled
It must be fed only straw
It must be washed before work

questions.text: If a man died without a son, who was to take his widow as wife?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says her husband's brother shall go in to her and take her as his wife.

answers.text: A stranger outside the family
The eldest man of the city
Her husband's brother
A Levite

questions.text: Why was the firstborn of this marriage to succeed in the name of the dead brother?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says it was so that the dead brother's name would not be blotted out of Israel.

answers.text: So that the widow could inherit the land
So that his name would not be blotted out of Israel
So that the elders would be satisfied
So that the child could become a priest

questions.text: Where was the widow to go if her husband's brother refused to marry her?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says she shall go up to the gate to the elders.

answers.text: To the priest at the altar
To the king's house
To the gate, to the elders
To her father's tent

questions.text: What did the widow do to the brother who refused, in the presence of the elders?
questions.explanation: She was to loose his sandal from his foot and spit in his face.

answers.text: Tore his cloak and threw dust on him
Cut his hair and sent him away
Took his staff and broke it
Loosed his sandal and spat in his face

questions.text: By what name was the house of the man who refused to be called in Israel?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says: "The house of him who had his sandal removed."

answers.text: The house of him who had his sandal removed
The house of the brother who refused
The house without a name
The house of the empty field

questions.text: What were the Israelites not allowed to have in their bag?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says they shall not have diverse weights in their bag, one heavy and one light.

answers.text: Coins of a foreign king
More than one shekel of gold
Diverse weights, one heavy and one light
Food for more than one day

questions.text: Whom did Amalek strike as Israel came out of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says Amalek struck the rearmost of Israel, all who were feeble behind, when they were faint and weary.

answers.text: The rearmost, all who were feeble behind
The priests carrying the holy things
The leaders at the front
The shepherds with the flocks

questions.text: What were the Israelites to do once Yahweh had given them rest from their enemies?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says they shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky and not forget.

answers.text: Make peace with Amalek
Build a city named after Amalek
Pay tribute to Amalek
Blot out the memory of Amalek
